runtimeCapture: overview resident-buffer accounting estimate, not performance or GPU-memory measurement
limits: Cells are processed sequentially and published geometry is disposed before the next cell; no whole-city mesh set is retained.
Aggregate bytes estimate possible cell resident buffers only; Three object/material overhead, prefabs, cover, scene retention, and GPU allocations are excluded.
This is evidence for a proposed 128 MiB budget decision, not all-city rendered/resident memory or device performance certification.
